name: Gunther Arcanus
summary: On an island in Brightwater Lake, Gunther Arcanus has escaped the Lich King's control and keeps apart from others. He believes every other undead remains a Scourge thrall.

sections.title: Breaking the Shackles
sections.body: During the Third War, the Scourge swept across the north and the Plague of Undeath killed Gunther, raising him into servitude. His arcane mastery and will let him break the Lich King's mental hold alone, without the weakening of the Lich King or Lady Sylvanas's help that others needed. Believing every other walking corpse remained a mindless Scourge thrall, Gunther withdrew to an island in Tirisfal Glades. Shambling guardians surround him, and he cuts off all contact with the living and the dead alike.

sections.title: The Prodigal Lich
sections.body: The Forsaken sought powerful allies against the Scourge, so they sent emissaries to claim Gunther's spellbook. In the Undercity, Bethor Iceshard recognized the handwriting as that of his long-lost peer. Bethor enchanted the returned grimoire, and Gunther demanded the destruction of local Scourge commanders. Through this, he learned that others had broken free. Convinced that Sylvanas's faction truly rebels against the Scourge, Gunther has made a pact with his former schoolmate to aid the Forsaken.

sections.title: A Student of Dalaran
sections.body: Before Lordaeron fell, Gunther studied the arcane arts as a promising Kirin Tor apprentice in Dalaran. With close friends Bethor Iceshard and Thule Ravenclaw, he secretly pursued necromancy despite the Kirin Tor's strict ban on dark magic. To mark their brotherhood, the three bound their apprentice wands together as one heirloom.

faq.answer: Gunther Arcanus was a Kirin Tor wizard from Dalaran who died during the Third War. Raised into undeath, he broke the Lich King's domination alone and withdrew to an island in Brightwater Lake, in Tirisfal Glades.

faq.q: Why does Gunther look like a regular Forsaken instead of a skeletal lich?
faq.answer: Traditional liches place their spirits in phylacteries and take monstrous, floating skeletal forms. Gunther gained lich-like necromantic power while keeping his original reanimated corpse, so he retains his mortal appearance.

faq.q: Why was Gunther living alone on an island?
faq.answer: After escaping the Lich King's control, Gunther believed he was the only undead with free will. Thinking all other walking dead were mindless Scourge slaves, he secluded himself and ordered his minions to strike down anyone who approached.

faq.q: How does Gunther know Bethor Iceshard?
faq.answer: Gunther and Bethor Iceshard were close friends and classmates at the Kirin Tor in Dalaran, where they studied with Thule Ravenclaw. The three bound their apprentice wands together to honor their friendship.
Yes. Gunther pledges himself to Bethor and the Forsaken cause after adventurers return his enchanted spellbook and kill the local Scourge agent Lillith Nefara, proving they oppose the Lich King.
Lillith Nefara is a Scourge agent stationed in Tirisfal Glades. Gunther demands her death as proof that an adventurer serves an enemy of the Lich King, rather than the Scourge.

angles.text: As an undead, Gunther is an exception among the Forsaken. His freedom shows that arcane training and iron will alone could sometimes break the Lich King's mental hold.
As a mage trained in Dalaran, Gunther reflects Kirin Tor wizards who secretly studied forbidden necromancy before the Scourge invaded Lordaeron.
As a warlock, Gunther shows how far forbidden study of dark arts and reanimation could reach beyond Dalaran's leaders' watch.
